record.notes: The agenda implements Initiative 10 of the National Digital Strategy (RCM 207/2024) and entered into force on 9 January 2026; the action plan may be updated by the minister responsible for State reform. As of October 2026 no law or decree designating Portugal's AI Act authorities had been published: the Government announced on 19 September 2025 that ANACOM would be the market surveillance authority and single point of contact, the Commission's list of 7 September 2026 shows ANACOM with the designation marked as pending, and ANACOM has published Portugal's list of Article 77 fundamental-rights authorities and consulted (16 June to 16 July 2026) on draft recommendations for implementing the Article 5 prohibitions. Two later resolutions listed by ANACOM under artificial intelligence (RCM 67/2026 on advanced-computing expenditure and RCM 178/2026 on the second phase of the AMALIA language model) do not concern safety or supervision.
